source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the fixed accepted revision, folderTree is a tree-listbox whose empty subclass uses TreeListboxMixin. Its selection getter returns the private Set of row elements, and swapSelection adds those elements. The single-folder reorder branch checks membership with rows.indexOf(row), a numeric index. This is a scoped static mismatch to validate before claiming that branch restores selection. The timeout helper later swaps the collected rows and focuses the tree, but this study did not exercise dragging, keyboard focus or accessibility. It does not establish a general rule for every Set or selection API.
title: Check the row representation in folder-reorder selection restoration
